page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text, no margin notes. The digitiser's banner at the foot is left out.

main_text.p: guo ambitu, quantus corniculatæ Lunæ figuræ respondet, deficiente. Decimo quinto die in uno Lunæ hemisphærio utriusq; Pyramidis bases coëunt & coniunguntur, & aspectui obijciuntur nostro, ideo πανσέληνον efficiunt, ut pleno lucere orbe videatur.

Ab Oppositione marcescens rursus, die decimo nono ἀμαυρούμενος contrario ordine. Vicesimo secundo διχότομος, vicesimo sexto μηνοειδής euadit. Tricesimo cum Sole denuo congreditur, quem congressum σύνοδον graeci & νέου μηνίαν, coniunctionem & coitum latini nominant, quo tempore nec ipsa in oculos incurrit, nec aliqua lumimis eius scintilla enitescit, totum enim lucidum Hemisphærium Soli obuersum, lumen cœlo regerit, opacum nos respicit, nec tunc se mutuo bases interfecant, in diuersis constitutæ Hemisphærijs, nisi raro admodum, cum magnam Lunæ πρόσλαξιν latitudinis habet, quæ tamen sectio angulos conformat adeo acutos, ut neutiquam partem de illuminato Hemisphærio sensibilem abscindat, de causis harum effigierum Lunæ demonstrationes eruditas studiosi requirant ex 4. libro opticæ Vitellionis, Capitib:74.75.76. & 77.

page.notes: Greek words are transcribed as best read from the scan; the Greek on the second paragraph is uncertain and marked by its sense. The catchword "Quod" at the foot right is treated as a catchword. Long s rendered as s. The leading word "Ab" is set in a larger initial form.
